definitions.explanation: The castle in central Osaka first built by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in the 1580s as the seat of his power. It fell to the Tokugawa in 1615 and was rebuilt; the present main tower is a 1931 concrete reconstruction housing a museum. It is the city's best-known landmark.

CULTURAL NOTE:
A well-known quiz asks who built Osaka Castle; the joke answer is 'the carpenters' (⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧さん), since Hideyoshi only ordered it built.
